leads.name: Las Americas Restaurant
leads.notes: Independent single-location Dominican/Latin restaurant. Google-listed website domain fails to resolve (DNS failure) — broken. Full menu with prices only on DoorDash/UberEats/Seamless; marketplace-only ordering, no direct channel. LIVE Google Maps check 2026-10-10: 3.8 stars / 257 reviews; 0 of 5 sampled reviews had an owner reply (full review list blocked by Maps sign-in wall) — owner replies rarely/never (+15). GBP Posts not yet checked (Maps check blocked by reCAPTCHA). No public email found. Score: broken site (30) + no owned menu (15) + rating below 4.3 (15) + marketplace-only ordering (15) + reviews unanswered (15).

Directory ratings only (4.0/182 dinepages; 3.8/794 menuweb aggregated) — NOT Google-confirmed. No public email found. Score: dead Google-listed site (30) + no owned menu (15) + rating below 4.3 (15) + no direct ordering (15). Correction applied 2026-10-10 ~11:30 EDT (draft observation was stale).

Rating ~3.9/~1.8K reviews Google-derived via top-rated.online — NOT Google-confirmed; restaurantji 3.5/270. Score: no website (30) + menu missing (15) + rating below 4.3 (15) + no direct ordering (15). Verified 2026-10-10.

Directory ratings only (4.5/356 carta.menu/menuweb; 4.5/50+ DoorDash) — NOT Google-confirmed. No public email found. Score: broken site (30) + no owned menu (15) + marketplace-only ordering (15). Verified 2026-10-10.
